entries.title: Psalms 133:1
segments: A Song of degrees; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant [it is] for brothers to dwell together in unity!

entries.title: Psalms 133:2
segments: [It is] like the precious ointment on the head that ran down on the beard, Aaron's beard, that went down to the mouth of his garments;

entries.title: Psalms 133:3
segments: like the dew of Hermon that came down on the mountains of Zion; for there the LORD commanded the blessing, life forevermore.
